Repository execution utilities

Usage:
  erun exec [command]

Available Commands:
  close-pr             Close the GitHub pull request a merge queue gate actually shipped
  commit               Commit every change, or only the declared paths, in the project working tree
  diff                 Show the current git diff
  gate-merge           Build the prospective merge a merge queue promotion (or batch) gates
  gate-run             Report a gate run's start and outcome to the erun platform
  job                  Start long work in the environment and observe it by handle
  merge                Merge a branch into the project working tree's current branch
  plan-ruleset-bypass  Plan narrowing a ruleset's bypass grant to one non-human queue identity
  push                 Push the project working tree's current branch to a remote
  raw                  Run a raw command from the project root
  reconcile-bypass     Check every ruleset-bypassed push against a real passed gate run
  report-commit-status Report a GitHub commit status for a merge queue gate result
  route-check          Prove every registered API route is reachable on a deployed plane
  write                Write stdin to a file in the project working tree

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for exec

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun exec [command] --help" for more information about a command.
